questions_and_answers.question_text: What kind of verb is zǒucuò le?
What is the literal make-up of zǒucuò le?
Give four other verbs formed with the syllable -cuò.
What are the two meanings of guò?
Can guò refer to time as well as space?
Write the Chinese for "You went the wrong way."
Write the Chinese for "Oh, I've bought the wrong thing!"
Write the Chinese for "Cross three streets, and that's Nánjīng East Road, Section 1."

answers.answer_text: Guò sāntiáo jiē, jiù shi Nánjīng Dōnglù Yīduàn.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Give the literal meaning of zǒucuò le.

answers.answer_text: "To have walked with the result of being wrong."

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "You read the clock wrong."

articles.text:
4. C: Wǒ zhǎo Zhōngshān Běilù.       I am looking for Zhōngshān North
                                      Road.

5. B: Nǐ zǒucuò le. Zhè shi          You went the wrong way. This is
      Nánjīng Xīlù.                   Nánjīng West Road.
   B: Nǐ wàng nàbian zǒu.            You go that way.
   B: Guò sāntiáo jiē, jiù shi       Cross three streets, and that's
      Nánjīng Dōnglù Yīduàn.          Nánjīng East Road, Section 1.

Notes on No. 5

Zǒucuò le is a compound verb of result. Zǒucuò le is literally zǒu, "to walk," and cuò, "to be wrong/mistaken/erroneous": "to have walked with the result of being wrong."

The marker le is used in "I'm wrong," Wǒ cuò le. Notice that the marker is also used for the compound verb zǒucuò le.

The syllable -cuò may be used with other action verbs to indicate a result. For instance, there is

shuōcuò le                       to have said incorrectly
tīngcuò le                       to have heard incorrectly
xiěcuò le                        to have written incorrectly
niàncuò le                       to have read (something aloud) incorrectly

Ou, wǒ mǎicuò le! Zhège          Oh, I've bought the wrong thing!
tài xiǎo le!                     This is too small!
Nǐ kàncuò le. Yínháng cóng       You read it wrong. The bank has
jiǔdiǎn zhōng jiù kāi mén        been open since 9 a.m.
le.
Nǐ kàncuòle zhōng, xiànzài       You read the clock wrong. It's
yǐjing bādiǎn bàn le.            already 8:30.

Guò, "to cross," "to pass": This word can refer to time as well as to space.

Guòle zhèige lùkǒu, zài wàng     After you have crossed this intersec-
qián zǒu bù yuǎn, jiù dào        tion, then go a little farther
nèige xuéxiào le.                ahead, and you'll be at the school.

A: Míngtian wǒ qǐng ni kàn       How about my treating you to a movie
diànyǐng, hǎo bu hǎo?            tomorrow?
B: Zhèi liǎngtian dōu yǒu        I have classes the next couple of
kè, guò liǎngtian zài            days; let's see about it in a
shuō ba.                         couple of days.

Wǒ xiǎng, guòle jǐge xīngqī,     I think that after a few weeks have
nǐde bìng jiù kěyi hǎo le.       passed your illness will be all
